hypothesis: Original NBM guidance adds incremental information conditional on a coherent market probability distribution, even though each standalone weather forecast loses to market quotes in E003 development validation.
status: New development hypothesis after examining E002/E003 losses and full-quote coverage; neither a fresh holdout nor a promotion experiment
quote_eligibility: Unchanged E002 exact historical candle rule: every member of an exhaustive/exclusive integer event must have 0 < bid < ask < 1 at the same decision. No missing-tail imputation or zero-boundary relaxation. Report all excluded events/horizons.
market_distribution: q_j = midpoint_j / sum(midpoints); retain the original independent midpoints as an additional binary-score benchmark. Normalized probabilities are forecasts, never executable prices.
cross_fitting: At each first day February through June, refit the six unchanged E003 weather methods using only earlier source days whose exchange settlement AND selected NWS report issue strictly precede that month boundary. Predict the next month, excluding all its labels from weather fitting. Combine these chronological out-of-fit predictions February-June. Keep the existing E003 July 1 weather artifact for final July-September development forecasts; no validation refit.
pool: p_j proportional to q_j^beta * max(weather_p_j,1e-6)^gamma. Normalize across the complete event. Fit beta,gamma in [0,3] by weighted multinomial negative log likelihood plus 0.5*((beta-1)^2+gamma^2). Market-only temperature baseline fits beta with gamma fixed zero on identical training events. Initial beta=1,gamma=0; L-BFGS-B analytic gradient, maxiter1000, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-8; no hyperparameter search.
weights: Each source day total one across its eligible events, separately for each horizon. Multinomial target is the single actual winning contract; binary scores average all six contracts, then events, then source days.
insufficient_fit: Retain an unavailable model/horizon and do not predict it. Do not lower the minimum or pool horizons after inspecting results.
evaluation: Retain all six weather combinations plus raw midpoint, normalized midpoint and fitted market-only temperature benchmarks. Compare each pool to all three market benchmarks using Brier, binary log loss and descriptive multiclass log loss. Report coherence and weights. No trading returns.
uncertainty: Same strict consecutive-calendar-day circular bootstrap as E002/E003: blocks 1/7/14, 10000 draws, seed20260906. Missing dates make confidence unavailable; no calendar compression. All six candidates, four horizons and three market references form the intended development family per metric/block. Missing fits/inference prevent reduced-family Holm claims. Global validation thresholds are unchanged.
source_limits: Inherits original source-window, issue/storage-vs-receipt, contract revision and selection limitations of E003. NBM guidance remains fixed from source-day start. Target is historical NWS; current TWC contracts require separate reconciliation.
